_comment: Rumors (GDD 8, Phase 3 step 2). witnesses: who tells the rumor (English working text; Russian: rumor_witness.<id> in locale/strings.csv). zones: per zone of the district map, the rumor pictures (art/ui/RUMOR__art__<id>.webp) and the creature tags that make a rumor land there more often.

witnesses.text: A washerwoman at the pump swears by every saint:
A drunk in the Lantern & Hook tells it while someone keeps pouring:
A grubby urchin whispers it for a copper:
The night watchman says it without looking at you:
An Ash Sister wrote it down from a patient's words:
An unsigned leaflet is pinned to the post by the bonfire:
The widow from the third floor has not slept for three nights:
